name: print-social-navy-poster-huge-thin-save-30-over-cafe-portrait
title: Navy band with giant thin white 'Save 30%' behind a smiling man with a phone in a cafe
whatItIs: A wide ad with a navy top band carrying giant thin white 'Save 30%' with the subject's curly hair overlapping the digits, a small 'with payno' line and a photo of a smiling man in a navy shirt with a phone at a cafe table.
whatItMeans: Warm and direct; the person breaks the type, tying offer and human moment.
techniques: Let the subject overlap giant thin type.
Match clothing to the navy band.
Put a small logo line under the number.

vocabulary.definition: A person in front of type.
A solid coloured strip at the top.
